pages.text: Thermal is the primary $(t2)Tier 2$(end) tech mod. Ore processing, machines, and Steel production.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Steel is the $(t2)T2$(end) baseline material. Thermal Smeltery produces Steel Ingots efficiently. The Series covers Energy, Dynamics (pipes/ducts), and Cultivation (farming machines).$(br2)$(bold)Ore processing:$(/bold) $(t2)Tier 2$(end) marks the start of ore doubling and tripling. A Thermal Smeltery + Pulverizer setup yields 2–3 ingots per ore.

$(bold)Material relevance:$(/bold) Signalum, Lumium, and Enderium are $(t2)Tier 2$(end)–$(t3)3$(end) Thermal alloys. Enderium is a $(t3)T3$(end) material in this pack.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$(/bold) Efficient Engineering passive boosts all Thermal machine speeds. A $(t2)T2$(end) Artificer with good Skill investment is significantly ahead on material production.

$(bold)No book needed.$(/bold) Thermal Series is fully documented in JEI — every machine recipe, augment slot, and component is listed. The $(bold)Thermal Manual$(/bold) item provides in-game tooltips when held.
